title: Subjuntivo e inversión formal
description: Vas a aprender el modo subjuntivo en inglés formal (it's essential that...) y las estructuras de inversión después de adverbios negativos o condicionales formales como were I to o had I known. Te sirve para escribir y hablar con un registro formal y sofisticado.
objectives: Vas a poder usar el subjuntivo formal después de verbos como suggest, insist y demand.
Vas a poder formar condicionales formales invertidos con were I to y were it not for.
Vas a poder usar hardly, scarcely y no sooner con inversión para marcar la sucesión rápida de dos acciones.
Vas a poder invertir el tercer condicional con had I known para lograr un registro más formal.
Vas a poder reescribir oraciones informales en un registro formal y sofisticado combinando subjuntivo e inversión.

subtopics.title: El subjuntivo con suggest, insist y demand
subtopics.goal: Vas a poder usar el subjuntivo formal después de verbos como suggest, insist, demand y recommend, y después de adjetivos como essential o crucial.
keyPoints: Después de suggest, insist, demand, recommend, propose + that, el verbo va en forma base (subjuntivo), sin -s ni cambio de tiempo: I suggest that he call back.
El subjuntivo no cambia según el sujeto ni el tiempo: se usa la misma forma base aunque el sujeto sea he, she o it.
También aparece después de it's + adjetivo (essential, crucial, vital, important) + that: It's essential that she be present.
La forma negativa es sujeto + not + verbo base: I insist that she not leave yet.
En español el subjuntivo cambia la terminación del verbo (que venga, que llame); en inglés simplemente usás la forma base del verbo, sin conjugar.
El inglés británico tiende a preferir should + infinitivo en este contexto (It's essential that she should be present), mientras que el estadounidense usa el subjuntivo directo con más frecuencia.

examples.target: I suggest that he call the client immediately.
examples.es: Sugiero que llame al cliente de inmediato.

examples.target: The committee insists that the report be submitted by Friday.
examples.es: El comité insiste en que el informe se presente antes del viernes.

examples.target: It's essential that everyone arrive on time.
examples.es: Es esencial que todos lleguen a tiempo.

examples.target: She demanded that the company pay for the damages.
examples.es: Ella exigió que la empresa pagara por los daños.

examples.target: The doctor recommended that he not smoke anymore.
examples.es: El médico recomendó que no fumara más.

examples.target: It's crucial that this information remain confidential.
examples.es: Es crucial que esta información permanezca confidencial.

examples.target: They proposed that the meeting be postponed.
examples.es: Propusieron que se postergara la reunión.

examples.target: The judge ordered that the documents be reviewed immediately.
examples.es: El juez ordenó que los documentos se revisaran de inmediato.

commonMistakes.wrong: I suggest that he calls the client.
commonMistakes.right: I suggest that he call the client.
commonMistakes.why: Después de suggest that usás la forma base del verbo (call), sin la -s de tercera persona, porque es subjuntivo.

commonMistakes.wrong: It's essential that she is present.
commonMistakes.right: It's essential that she be present.
commonMistakes.why: Después de it's essential that, el verbo va en forma subjuntiva base (be), no conjugado como is.

commonMistakes.wrong: She demanded that the company paid for the damages.
commonMistakes.right: She demanded that the company pay for the damages.
commonMistakes.why: El subjuntivo no cambia de tiempo aunque la oración principal esté en pasado; se usa siempre la forma base (pay), no paid.

chunks.example: It's essential that the data remain confidential.
chunks.exampleEs: Es esencial que los datos permanezcan confidenciales.

subtopics.title: Were I to y condicionales formales invertidos
subtopics.goal: Vas a poder formar condicionales hipotéticos formales invirtiendo el sujeto y were, sin usar if.
keyPoints: Were I to + infinitivo reemplaza a if I were to en un registro muy formal: Were I to win the lottery, I would travel the world.
La estructura funciona con cualquier sujeto: were she, were they, were the company, siempre con to + infinitivo después del sujeto.
Were it not for + sustantivo significa si no fuera por algo, y reemplaza a if it weren't for: Were it not for your help, I wouldn't have succeeded.

También podés invertir were directamente antes de un complemento (sin to) cuando no hay un verbo principal, como en Were I you o Were I in your position, equivalentes a if I were you / in your position.
Esta inversión se usa casi exclusivamente en escritura formal, discursos y textos académicos o legales, no en conversaciones informales.
En español no hay una estructura idéntica; el registro formal se logra más con el vocabulario que con la gramática, así que esta inversión hay que aprenderla como patrón fijo.

examples.target: Were I to win the lottery, I would travel around the world.
examples.es: Si yo ganara la lotería, viajaría por el mundo.

examples.target: Were she to apply, she would surely get the job.
examples.es: Si ella se postulara, seguramente conseguiría el trabajo.

examples.target: Were it not for your support, I wouldn't have succeeded.
examples.es: Si no fuera por tu apoyo, no habría tenido éxito.

examples.target: Were the company to lose this contract, hundreds of jobs would be at risk.
examples.es: Si la empresa perdiera este contrato, cientos de empleos estarían en riesgo.

examples.target: Were we to postpone the launch, we would lose our competitive edge.
examples.es: Si postergáramos el lanzamiento, perderíamos nuestra ventaja competitiva.

examples.target: Were it not for the rain, the event would have been held outdoors.
examples.es: Si no fuera por la lluvia, el evento se habría hecho al aire libre.

examples.target: Were they to agree to the terms, the deal would close by Friday.
examples.es: Si ellos aceptaran los términos, el trato se cerraría para el viernes.

examples.target: Were I in your position, I would accept the offer.
examples.es: Si yo estuviera en tu posición, aceptaría la oferta.

commonMistakes.wrong: I were to win the lottery, I would travel.
commonMistakes.right: Were I to win the lottery, I would travel.
commonMistakes.why: En la forma invertida, were va antes del sujeto (Were I), no después; si no se invierte, hay que usar if.

commonMistakes.wrong: Were not it for your help, I wouldn't have succeeded.
commonMistakes.right: Were it not for your help, I wouldn't have succeeded.
commonMistakes.why: El orden fijo es were it not for, con not después de it, no antes.

commonMistakes.wrong: Were she apply, she would get the job.
commonMistakes.right: Were she to apply, she would get the job.
commonMistakes.why: Después de were + sujeto necesitás to + infinitivo; no se puede omitir el to.

chunks.example: Were I to accept this offer, I would have to relocate.
chunks.exampleEs: Si yo aceptara esta oferta, tendría que trasladarme.

chunks.example: Were it not for his guidance, the project would have failed.
chunks.exampleEs: Si no fuera por su guía, el proyecto habría fracasado.

chunks.example: Thousands of jobs would be at risk if the factory closed.
chunks.exampleEs: Miles de empleos estarían en riesgo si cerrara la fábrica.

chunks.example: Were they to agree, we could close the deal this week.
chunks.exampleEs: Si ellos aceptaran, podríamos cerrar el trato esta semana.

subtopics.title: Hardly, scarcely y no sooner con inversión
subtopics.goal: Vas a poder usar hardly, scarcely y no sooner al principio de la oración con inversión para describir dos acciones que ocurren casi al mismo tiempo.
keyPoints: Cuando hardly, scarcely o no sooner van al principio de la oración, se invierte el orden: had + sujeto + participio.
Estructura con hardly/scarcely: Hardly/Scarcely had + sujeto + participio + when/before + cláusula: Hardly had I arrived when the phone rang.
Estructura con no sooner: No sooner had + sujeto + participio + than + cláusula: No sooner had he sat down than the alarm went off.
Después de hardly y scarcely usás when o before; después de no sooner usás than, nunca when.
Sin inversión, la versión menos formal sería: She had hardly left when it started to rain, con el mismo significado pero menos literario.

examples.target: Hardly had I arrived when the phone rang.
examples.es: Apenas había llegado cuando sonó el teléfono.

examples.target: Scarcely had she finished speaking when the audience began to applaud.
examples.es: Apenas había terminado de hablar cuando el público empezó a aplaudir.

examples.target: No sooner had he sat down than the alarm went off.
examples.es: Apenas se había sentado cuando sonó la alarma.

examples.target: Hardly had the meeting started when the fire alarm went off.
examples.es: Apenas había empezado la reunión cuando sonó la alarma de incendio.

examples.target: No sooner had they announced the results than people started celebrating.
examples.es: Apenas habían anunciado los resultados cuando la gente empezó a festejar.

examples.target: Scarcely had I closed the door when I heard a knock.
examples.es: Apenas había cerrado la puerta cuando escuché que golpeaban.

examples.target: Hardly had the plane taken off when the turbulence began.
examples.es: Apenas había despegado el avión cuando empezaron las turbulencias.

examples.target: No sooner had she signed the contract than she regretted it.
examples.es: Apenas había firmado el contrato cuando se arrepintió.

commonMistakes.wrong: Hardly I had arrived when the phone rang.
commonMistakes.right: Hardly had I arrived when the phone rang.
commonMistakes.why: Al invertir, had va antes del sujeto (had I), no después; el orden normal se rompe justamente por la inversión.

commonMistakes.wrong: No sooner had he sat down when the alarm went off.
commonMistakes.right: No sooner had he sat down than the alarm went off.
commonMistakes.why: Después de no sooner siempre se usa than, nunca when; es un error muy común mezclar las dos estructuras.

commonMistakes.wrong: Hardly had I arrived than the phone rang.
commonMistakes.right: Hardly had I arrived when the phone rang.
commonMistakes.why: Después de hardly y scarcely se usa when o before, no than; than es exclusivo de no sooner.

chunks.example: Scarcely had she arrived when she was asked to leave.
chunks.exampleEs: Apenas había llegado cuando le pidieron que se fuera.

chunks.example: No sooner had I fallen asleep than the alarm went off.
chunks.exampleEs: Apenas me había quedado dormido cuando sonó la alarma.

subtopics.title: Had I known: inversión en el tercer condicional
subtopics.goal: Vas a poder invertir el tercer condicional usando had + sujeto + participio en lugar de if + had, para lograr un registro más formal.
keyPoints: En el tercer condicional formal, Had + sujeto + participio reemplaza a If + sujeto + had + participio: Had I known about the problem, I would have fixed it.
La estructura completa es: Had + sujeto + participio, + sujeto + would have + participio.
La forma negativa invertida es Had + sujeto + not + participio, nunca Had not + sujeto: Had I not known...
Had it not been for + sustantivo significa si no hubiera sido por algo, muy usado para expresar agradecimiento o causa en el pasado: Had it not been for your advice, I would have made a mistake.
Este registro es más formal y literario que If I had known, y se usa mucho en discursos, informes y textos legales.

examples.target: Had I known about the problem, I would have fixed it immediately.
examples.es: Si hubiera sabido del problema, lo habría solucionado de inmediato.

examples.target: Had she arrived earlier, she would have caught the train.
examples.es: Si hubiera llegado antes, habría alcanzado el tren.

examples.target: Had it not been for your advice, I would have made a huge mistake.
examples.es: Si no hubiera sido por tu consejo, habría cometido un gran error.

examples.target: Had they listened to the warnings, the accident could have been avoided.
examples.es: Si hubieran escuchado las advertencias, el accidente se podría haber evitado.

examples.target: Had I not studied so hard, I wouldn't have passed the exam.
examples.es: Si no hubiera estudiado tanto, no habría aprobado el examen.

examples.target: Had the company invested earlier, it would have avoided bankruptcy.
examples.es: Si la empresa hubiera invertido antes, habría evitado la quiebra.

examples.target: Had we known the traffic would be so bad, we would have left earlier.
examples.es: Si hubiéramos sabido que el tráfico iba a estar tan mal, habríamos salido antes.

examples.target: Had it not been for the rain, the match would have continued.
examples.es: Si no hubiera sido por la lluvia, el partido habría continuado.

commonMistakes.wrong: If had I known about the problem, I would have fixed it.
commonMistakes.right: Had I known about the problem, I would have fixed it.
commonMistakes.why: No se usa if junto con la inversión; elegís una de las dos formas, nunca las dos juntas.

commonMistakes.wrong: Had I known, I would fixed it.
commonMistakes.right: Had I known, I would have fixed it.
commonMistakes.why: La cláusula de resultado necesita would have + participio; no podés omitir have.

commonMistakes.wrong: Had not I known about the problem.
commonMistakes.right: Had I not known about the problem.
commonMistakes.why: En la forma negativa invertida, not va después del sujeto (I not), no antes del sujeto.

chunks.example: Had it not been for the quick response of the team, the damage would have been worse.
chunks.exampleEs: Si no hubiera sido por la respuesta rápida del equipo, el daño habría sido peor.

chunks.example: Had I known you were coming, I would have cooked something special.
chunks.exampleEs: Si hubiera sabido que venías, habría cocinado algo especial.

chunks.example: The delay could have been avoided with better planning.
chunks.exampleEs: La demora se podría haber evitado con una mejor planificación.

chunks.example: Without your warning, I would have made a mistake.
chunks.exampleEs: Sin tu advertencia, habría cometido un error.

subtopics.title: Reescribir oraciones en registro formal
subtopics.goal: Vas a poder leer oraciones en registro neutro y reescribirlas usando subjuntivo o inversión formal, según corresponda.
keyPoints: Para recomendaciones o exigencias, transformás should + infinitivo en subjuntivo formal: You should submit the report → It is essential that the report be submitted.
Para condiciones hipotéticas, transformás if + were/past en were... to invertido: If the board agreed... → Were the board to agree...

Para secuencias rápidas de eventos, transformás as soon as en no sooner... than o hardly... when, con inversión: As soon as she sat down, the lights went out → No sooner had she sat down than the lights went out.
Para condicionales irreales del pasado, transformás if + had en had invertido: If you had told me... → Had you told me...
El registro formal se reconoce no solo por la gramática, sino también por evitar contracciones y usar vocabulario más elevado (propose, essential, crucial) en vez de formas coloquiales.

examples.target: Had you told me earlier, I would have helped you.
examples.es: Si me lo hubieras dicho antes, te habría ayudado.

examples.target: Were the board to agree, we would proceed with the merger.
examples.es: Si la junta estuviera de acuerdo, procederíamos con la fusión.

examples.target: It is essential that you submit your application before Friday.
examples.es: Es esencial que envíes tu solicitud antes del viernes.

examples.target: No sooner had she sat down than the lights went out.
examples.es: Apenas se había sentado cuando se apagaron las luces.

examples.target: Had I not received your email, I wouldn't have known about the change.
examples.es: Si no hubiera recibido tu correo, no me habría enterado del cambio.

examples.target: The manager recommended that employees work from home.
examples.es: El gerente recomendó que los empleados trabajaran desde casa.

examples.target: Were it not for the support of the team, the project would have failed.
examples.es: Si no fuera por el apoyo del equipo, el proyecto habría fracasado.

examples.target: We propose that the deadline be extended by one week.
examples.es: Proponemos que se extienda el plazo una semana.

commonMistakes.wrong: Were the board agree, we would proceed.
commonMistakes.right: Were the board to agree, we would proceed.
commonMistakes.why: Al reescribir con were invertido, no podés omitir el to + infinitivo después del sujeto.

commonMistakes.wrong: No sooner she had sat down than the lights went out.
commonMistakes.right: No sooner had she sat down than the lights went out.
commonMistakes.why: En la inversión con no sooner, had va antes del sujeto (had she), no después.

commonMistakes.wrong: We propose that the deadline is extended.
commonMistakes.right: We propose that the deadline be extended.
commonMistakes.why: Después de propose that necesitás la forma subjuntiva base (be extended), no el verbo conjugado (is extended).

chunks.example: It is essential that the information be verified before publication.
chunks.exampleEs: Es esencial que la información se verifique antes de publicarse.
